g.title: Meeting hall / clinic: A public hall hastily divided into a ward and a treatment room.
Ration office / private flat: Crates and the public counter below; a comfortable private room and telephone upstairs.
Cooperative shop: A full stockroom behind an almost empty shop counter.
Garden house: A small home with the dining table still laid and a little garden behind it.
Market store: Pallets and open crates link the store to the outdoor stalls.
Workers boarding house: A shared dining room below and simple beds upstairs.
Square canteen: Tables face the square; supplies are pushed into the back corner.
Garden tool shed: Tools, spare parts and an improvised workbench.
